### 🇨🇳 中文更新日志
* 🖥️ **新增 macOS 桌面拖拽快速上传**：支持直接向 App 窗口内拖拽文件及文件夹快速触发 SFTP 上传，适配多显示器布局并精调保存路径确认对话框。
* ⚙️ **重构“关于与系统”标签页**：将原有臃肿的设置页大拆分为独立的 `系统设置`（偏好设置、安全隐私、缓存清理、重置注销）与 `关于我们`（软件信息、诊断日志、更新检查与源码审计），界面层级更加清爽科学。
* 🎨 **新增顶部标题栏背景自定义**：支持设定顶部标题栏背景，提供官方预设渐变色并支持本地图片上传，引入防白高对比度蒙版与临时文件沙盒安全化机制。
* 📊 **优化仪表盘折线图垂向对齐**：精调所有监控图表的水平等分垂线间距至相同尺寸，使得 CPU、网速等图表的横轴时间刻度完美对齐，方便跨指标趋势关联分析。
* 📈 **优化图表背景网格与 GPU 展现**：统一所有数据折线图为高保真正方形网格背景，精简 GPU 状态指标展现，聚焦核心占用数据。
* 🔒 **优化顶部标题隐私安全度**：顶部标题副状态栏移除内网 IP 地址及 UUID 的直接展示，避免截图或录屏时造成隐私敏感信息泄露。
* ⌨️ **优化终端二次验证防冲突交互**：禁用了二次验证输入框的自动聚焦，防止进入终端页面时手机虚拟键盘自动弹起与系统的指纹/面容验证弹窗产生冲突阻碍。

### 🇺🇸 English Changelog
* 🖥️ **New macOS Global Drag-and-Drop Upload**: Directly drag files or folders into the application window to trigger quick SFTP transfers, complete with multi-display mapping and an optimized destination directory selector.
* ⚙️ **Refactored Settings Reorganization**: Split the cluttered "About & System" tab into a dedicated `System Settings` panel (handling preferences, custom backgrounds, security locks, cache, reset) and an `About Us` section (showing version info, manual update checkers, diagnostic logs, and security links).
* 🎨 **New Custom Header Backgrounds**: Allows personalizing the top navigation banner, featuring premium gradient presets and custom local image uploads with a 35% black opacity contrast overlay and sandboxed persistent file copying.
* 📊 **Optimized Telemetry Chart Alignment**: Standardized division alignments across all monitoring sparklines, ensuring time-axis vertical alignment for synchronized trend comparison across CPU and network metrics.
* 📈 **Refactored Grid Backgrounds & GPU Layout**: Standardized all telemetry chart backgrounds to high-fidelity square grids and streamlined the GPU dashboard card to highlight crucial utilization details.
* 🔒 **Enhanced Header Title Privacy**: Removed the local IP address and UUID strings from the status subtitle, protecting sensitive configuration details during screenshots or screen recordings.
* ⌨️ **Refactored Terminal Re-verification Keypad**: Disabled text field autofocus on the 4-digit PIN screen to stop the soft keyboard from popping up automatically and clashing with system biometric auth dialogs.
